answer: Pay public goods with quadratic matching plus pairwise-correlation discounting. A contribution earns matching by its square root, but identities whose funding histories keep overlapping are grouped and matched once, not per clone. A fresh identity is a comet that only passes once: with no history it earns almost no match until it builds a distinct record across many epochs. The narrow inlet is time: faking diversity means funding many unrelated projects from many wallets for months, burning real capital, while honest agents rest on velvet-smooth standing already earned.
